commands: '=== IIS https bindings that mention s6 or have NO host header (fallback) ==='

Get-Website | ForEach-Object { $n=$_.Name; $_.Bindings.Collection | Where-Object { $_.protocol -eq 'https' } | ForEach-Object { if ($_.bindingInformation -match ':s6\.eightfoldway\.com$' -or $_.bindingInformation -match '^\*?:443:$') { "$n | $($_.bindingInformation) | sslFlags=$($_.sslFlags)" } } }
'=== http.sys SSL cert mappings (hostname:port SNI + 0.0.0.0:443 default) ==='
$out = netsh http show sslcert; $out | Select-String -Pattern 's6\.eightfoldway|0.0.0.0:443|\[::\]:443|:443' -Context 0,6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
'=== does cert 8CA90463 exist in LocalMachine\My and cover s6? ==='

Get-ChildItem Cert:\LocalMachine\My | Where-Object { $_.Thumbprint -like '8CA90463*' } | ForEach-Object { "thumb=$($_.Thumbprint) NotAfter=$($_.NotAfter.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'))"; "  subject=$($_.Subject)"; "  SANs=$(($_.DnsNameList | ForEach-Object { $_.Unicode }) -join ', ')" }
'=== quick: any https binding cert hash for the s6 name (netsh focused) ==='
(netsh http show sslcert hostnameport=s6.eightfoldway.com:443) 2>$null | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match 'Hostname|Certificate Hash|s6' }
